scorecard.title: College Scorecard (location, enrollment, cost; data released 2026-10-15)

cds.title: Kenyon College Common Data Set 2025-2026 (Excel, Office of Institutional Research)

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs for 2026-27 from the Common Data Set (G1, G5); Kenyon's tuition-and-costs page shows the same comprehensive fee (tuition $72,880, housing $9,080, meals $10,780, student activities fee $350, total $93,090). Room and board = housing $9,080 + meal plan $10,780 (all students live on campus). Estimated expenses: books and supplies $1,900; other shown = transportation $900 + other expenses $1,490. No total cost of attendance is published for 2026-27 in the CDS (Kenyon's page gives $96,940 for 2025-26). H6: 149 undergraduate degree-seeking nonresidents received institutional aid, average $73,082 (need-based and non-need-based together).

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (fall 2025 entering class): 7,091 applied, 2,138 admitted (30.2%), 412 enrolled; the male/female/unknown rows add up to these totals. The 2025-26 CDS form has no in-state, out-of-state or international applicant rows, so those counts are left blank (39 of the 412 enrolled first-years are nonresidents, B2). Waitlist: 1,439 offered a place, 808 accepted, 63 admitted. Early Decision (C21, both plans together): 663 applications, 231 admitted. SAT/ACT are optional: only 7.5% of first-years (30 students) submitted SAT and 8% (33 students) submitted ACT scores, so the percentile ranges describe small groups. The average GPA of 4.15 is above 4.0, so many schools reported weighted GPAs; 93.7% of first-years reported a GPA, and the bands add up to 100% (0% below 1.0). Undergraduate enrollment (1,589) is the CDS degree-seeking undergraduates (B1: 708 men + 881 women, all full-time); the CDS 'Total all undergraduates' of 2,052 also counts 463 part-time 'other undergraduates enrolled in credit courses' (159 men, 304 women) and is not used. The international count (168) is the nonresident degree-seeking undergraduates (B2; the total-undergraduates nonresident figure is also 168).
